defects.detail: 'νῦν ψᾶφον ἑλισσομέναν ὅπα κῦμα κατακλύσσει' (now the rolling pebble, how the wave washes it away) -> 'Now, like a wave that flows and overwhelms' drops the pebble image
'νέμει γὰρ ἀτρέκειαν πόλιν Λοκρῶν' (Exactitude governs the Locrians' city) -> Atrekeia dropped; Kalliope and Ares made subject: 'Kalliope and bronze-clad Ares frequent the city'
'δάπε [τράπε] δὲ Κυκνεία μάχα καὶ ὑπέρβιον Ἡρακλέα' (the fight with Kyknos turned back even mighty Herakles) -> 'The fight with Kyknos and the overbearing Herakles are issues for them'
'Ἰόλᾳ φερέτω χάριν' (let him render thanks to Iolas/Ilas) -> 'carry away gratitude', trainer's name dropped

reason: Opening and closing strophes = source, but the epode drops Atrekeia, the pebble image and the trainer's name, and mistranslates the Kyknos clause

defects.detail: page-opening fragment 'τεύειν' (end of the previous quote) rendered as a headword 'niphosibeis <gloss>snow-covered</gloss>'
'ἀσεϊζόμενοι' (=ἀστεϊζόμενοι, jesting) -> 'acting insolently'
'Βεργινίᾳ τινὸς ἀνδρὸς ... θυγατέρα' -> 'a virgin daughter of a certain man', the name Verginia dropped

reason: Suda entries rendered faithfully throughout; slips are the opening fragment turned into a headword, 'insolently' for jesting, and the dropped name Verginia

defects.detail: '共得面方一十七百二十八尺' (garbled; the sum is 181,728, which the following ÷6 = 30,288 confirms) -> 'a total surface square of 172,800 feet'
gloss on bu 'approximately 5 feet', whereas the text divides by six (六而一) feet per bu

reason: Calculation steps (30,288 bu; 917,362,944; 9,173,629 mu 4 fen 4 li) = source; garbled total rendered as a wrong confident 172,800, and the bu gloss is wrong

defects.detail: 'Destu qui patience a nom / Cest celluy qui me fait chanter' (of this [gambeson], which is named Patience, it is that which makes me sing) -> 'Is it thou who art named Patience / It is she who makes me sing'
summary has 'Patience, who explains the virtue of divesting oneself', a character the page does not have
margin 'Beatus pater frenase peupertote iu se et in eius ira adeo diligebat' -> 'she was fond of poverty in herself, and in her anger she was so diligent'
'pro defunctis exorare' margin -> 'to provide for the deceased'

reason: Verse dialogue and Latin margins largely = source; misreads the gambeson-named-Patience couplet (and the summary repeats the error), and papers over a garbled margin

defects.detail: source ends 'ex Basilii Triumphwagen'; translation continues 'of Antimony, page 66 ... coin ... bread follows ... Dr. Kerger, On Fermentation ... iron follows the magnet', all from the next page
'Albertus Magnus Ulyssis Aldrovandi Dominus Johannes Veslingius' -> 'Albertus Magnus, the master of Ulysses Aldrovandi'
'de Judaeo Veneto Jordanus' (a Venetian Jew) -> 'certain Jewish impostors in Venice'

reason: This page's text is well rendered, but a whole passage from the next page (coin and bread tests, Kerger) is appended; also small slips with names

defects.detail: 'Nec errorem effugiunt Heinrici Stephani ... nec Scapula' (neither Stephanus nor Scapula escape error) -> 'Nor do the errors escape the notice of Heinricus Stephanus ... nor Scapula'
'caput mediae canis praecisae' (the front half of a dog cut through the middle) -> 'the head of a dog was cut in two'

reason: Otherwise = source, but it reverses the sentence charging Stephanus and Scapula with error, and garbles Livy's halved dog
Divine epithets and the closing yehi ratzon prayer = source, with unclear marking kept; ע"כ as 'therefore' and margin נק as 'Point' are defensible readings

defects.detail: headers '四聲' and '七聲' (fourth tone, seventh tone, matching 一音/二音/四音) -> 'Four Tones', 'Seven Tones', while 一音 is 'First Sound'
phonological sample characters glossed by lexical meaning, e.g. '早吾' -> 'Early Me', '早蚪' -> 'Early Tadpole'

reason: Table cells map one-to-one onto source and the margin and title are rendered; ordinal headers are made into cardinals, and the representative characters are rendered by their word meanings
Cork and elder-pith balls, the 24 feet, air hindrance, Galileo's vacuum assumption: all = source; nothing wrong found

defects.detail: 'daft. in rational.' (tail of the citation 'Gol-dast. in rational.') -> 'foolish in rational matters'

reason: Charles's journey, Leo's oath, 300 beheaded, the exile to Gaul and the 33 years all = source; only the opening citation fragment is turned into invented prose
Monday and Thursday fasts, Bava Kama and Megilla, Rigaltius on stations, Pythagoras's fish symbol, Albaspinaeus and the kiss, the marginal sigla: all = source

defects.detail: garbled 'وتوت قنه', 'ووببي حمام مسحور', 'وعمور هاورها ديه', 'ويحمد على الله علمه وسلم' -> fluent 'Lut and his guidance', 'his innocence, and the magic-bound', ''Amr, and their guidance', 'he who praises God for His knowledge, and peace'
meta 'continues from previous page: ...and Noah' renders 'ونوح' from the previous page

reason: Prophet and virtue pairs that are legible (Abraham/حلمه, Moses/أمنه, Daniel/حكمته, Abu Bakr) = source, but many garbled spans are rendered as confident names and virtues; I read this manuscript Arabic only moderately

defects.detail: source ends 'quum nihil ad inspirandam Φιλαυτίαν, & quae hanc perpetuo'; translation inserts 'nothing is more <unclear>effective</unclear>', anticipating 'efficacius sit' on the next page

reason: Thales preferring Pythagoras, the advice to go to the Memphite and Jupiter priests, and the footnote all = source; one word anticipated from the next page

defects.detail: the cited verse list '浮雲樹色嘉陵心落日江聲襟韻未萬里虞先生舊昔五更霜氣入人衣秋生庾園鷄歸少客到高樓蛺語多等恥杜瀾微亭難高岑未少處' -> narrative prose 'evoke Master Yu ... the shame of the Du pavilion, and it is difficult to reach the heights of Cen ... There is not a place that is lacking'
notes '1780 or 1840' for 庚子 and 'Yu Ji, a Yuan dynasty poet' for 虞先生 are unsupported identifications
'李醇溪念齋' -> 'Yi Chun-gye and Niam-jae' (Sun-gye, Yeom-jae)

reason: The Korea-versus-China poetics and the praise of Puwon = source, but the closing catalogue of quoted verses is made into invented narrative prose; the handwritten text's OCR is itself partly garbled
